loginLede: Sign in to operate the plant pendant
twoFactorLede: Optional email one-time codes at sign-in. STOP and motion never wait on 2FA once you are signed in.
stealControlHint: Enter your reset PIN to take exclusive control.
pinHint: The PIN is only used to reset e-stop after STOP.
holdHint: Hold motion buttons: deadman pulses while pressed. Release to stop.
noAlarmFrequency: No alarm counts in this window
phoneVoiceHint: Listen needs a local debug build (npx expo run:android), not Expo Go.
cameraPermissionDenied: Allow camera when your browser asks.
cameraPermissionSettingsHint: Camera is blocked for this site. Open site settings (lock or controls icon in the address bar), allow Camera, then reload this page.
cameraPermissionBlocked: Camera access is blocked. Allow the camera for this app in system settings, then try again.
err.motion: Motion blocked: claim control, hold deadman, and ensure normal safety mode
err.face: Face match failed — use password login
err.faceLiveness: Liveness failed — turn your head more between each capture
faceEnrolled: Face enrolled. You can use Face login next time.
faceSignedIn: Signed in with face. Opening operator…
faceEnrollOnlyHint: Enroll your face for faster sign-in next time. To sign in with face, sign out and choose Face login on the password screen.
tour.offHint: Turn on Tour help to see tips on every control.
tour.login.language: Pick English, Español, Français, or Deutsch. Your choice can be saved on your user after sign-in.
tour.login.signIn: Signs you in (email 2FA if enabled on your account), then opens Operator.
tour.login.face: Optional face login (3-pose challenge). Local skin-shape matcher — not ISO-certified; a drawing moved in frame can pass. Never for STOP, reset PIN, or motion. Prefer password.
tour.operator.nav: Open Media, Assistant, Face, Ops, Config, Audit, Account, or log out.
tour.operator.claim: Claim exclusive control before buttons work. Release when done. Take control with Reset PIN if someone else holds it.
tour.operator.banner: Safety mode: normal allows motion; e_stop blocks until reset; deadman HOLD shows while you hold a move. Claim control and hold Enable for P03A21 jogs.
tour.operator.plantScreens: Switch plant screens for this device. Admins Activate a shared default; Copy/Delete inactive screens in Config → Background.
tour.operator.graphic: Active plant picture with live labels from configured registers. Default demo is the P03A21 pendant layout.
tour.operator.safePin: STOP is one press (no PIN). Type Reset PIN here only to rearm e-stop after STOP.
tour.operator.matrix: P03A21 buttons and rockers. Claim control first. Hold Enable for jog motion. STOP stays in the bottom dock and never needs the PIN.
tour.operator.jogSpeed: Slow / Fast sets speed for variable-speed jogs while you hold a motion button.
tour.operator.holdHint: Press and hold motion controls; release to stop. Deadman pulses while held. On phone, hold Enable with another finger for Listen or a jog.
tour.media.camera: Device camera for QR/barcode in the frame. Grant permission if blocked. Plant RTSP notes are separate admin setup.
tour.media.qr: Type or scan an exact payload (TP-P03A21 → Operator, TP-OPS → Ops). Resolve opens the code’s route. Admins edit codes in Config.
tour.header.voice: Header mic: claim control, hold Enable on Operator, then Listen. Say stop, owva up/down, move home, and other P03A21 names.
tour.media.voice: Voice Listen is in the top header (not this page). Hold Enable on Operator. Timed jogs need Allow timed media motion in Config → Safety.
tour.ops.diagnostics: PLC link, active connection label, last error, safety mode, watchdog, and API uptime.
tour.ops.alarms: Active, acknowledged, or shelved alarms from your alarm rules.
tour.ops.ack: Ack means you saw it. Shelve (supervisor) parks it. Unshelve brings it back. A recovered condition clears it.
tour.ops.window: 24h / 7d / 30d sets the window for history, frequency, and CSV download.
tour.ops.history: Past raises in the selected window, including cleared. Download CSV for a report.
tour.ops.frequency: Which alarms happened most often in the selected window.
tour.ops.trends: History charts for registers marked Trend in Config (P03A21 speed/comms/fault when seeded).
tour.face.title: Face enroll/login with a 3-pose challenge. Not a security control (drawn pictures can pass). Never for e-stop. Fail closed to password.
tour.face.enroll: Enroll only after password login. Local template on this server; re-enroll replaces it. Not ISO-certified.
tour.face.login: Match three challenge frames to the stored template, then open Operator. On phone, face login is from the sign-in screen.
tour.audit.title: Who changed settings, safety, motion, or auth.
tour.audit.filters: Filter by date range and user, then Export CSV for the matching rows.
tour.audit.list: Each row shows user, action, resource, result, and time.
tour.assistant.title: Local manual search (SQLite FTS). Optional Cursor Agent only if the server has a key. Advisory — does not move the plant.
tour.assistant.docs: Admins set the docs folder, public link, and Reindex after manuals change.
tour.assistant.suggestions: Tap a suggested topic to fill the question, then Ask.
tour.assistant.ask: Ask about deadman, Modbus, alarms, wiring, P03A21, and more in plain language.
tour.config.users: Create operators and supervisors, reset passwords, and suspend accounts. Admins only.
tour.config.plc: Host, port, unit id, and protocol (Modbus TCP, Modbus TLS, or OPC UA). Use this PLC selects the active link; TLS/OPC security fields appear when needed.
tour.config.registers: Map each name to a Modbus address (and OPC UA node id when needed). Trend stores history for Ops. Safety renames may need Reset PIN.
tour.config.cells: Buttons for the selected plant screen. P03A21 rockers use two coils; Enable gates jogs. Admins can Reset P03A21 demo layout. STOP cannot be deleted.
tour.config.labels: Live text overlays on that screen’s picture, tied to a register and format. Drag on the graphic after upload (web).
tour.config.background: Plant screens: create, Copy, Delete (inactive only), Activate default, upload SVG/PNG/PDF. Each screen has its own buttons and labels.
tour.config.codes: Exact QR/barcode payload, label, and optional screen after Media Resolve (e.g. TP-P03A21 → Operator).
tour.config.alarms: Create rules: name, register, compare operator, threshold, severity, enabled.
tour.config.safety: Bind E-stop, deadman, heartbeat, and safe-state registers. Allow timed media motion enables header/phone voice jogs without holding a cell.
